transcript.text: my ex smashed my car windows last night. there's a protection order against him

Hi, I'm Sam, Wattle's AI claims assistant. A person is available any time if you'd prefer. I'm sorry this has happened. If you're in danger right now, please call 000.

Are you safe at the moment?

I think I'm safe for now. He left last night and I haven't seen him since. I'm still really scared, though. I have an AVO against him, so I just want to get the car sorted and make sure he can't find out where I am.

Thank you for telling me. Being scared after this makes sense. I'd like to pass you to a person who can help with the car claim and keep your details private. If you're ever in danger, call 000.

What's a safe way and time for us to contact you?

My mobile is the only safe number. Please don't call the home phone. I'm not sure of the exact number off the top of my head, but it's in my profile, so you can use that. Please don't send anything to the house address either. Email is fine if it's not going to the house. I'm usually free after 5pm on weekdays, but I can also do a call during my lunch break if that's easier.

I've passed you to a person, and someone from our team is joining this chat now.

I've given them a summary of what happened. I've told them to contact you only on your mobile, never the home phone, and not to send anything to the house. I've also passed on that you're free after 5pm on weekdays or at lunchtime. If you're ever in danger, call 000.
